title: HiringPolicy
description: Declarative, human-authored hiring policy source. HR declares requirements; they do NOT hand-configure dimension weights or JSON contracts. The Hiring Policy Compiler (PWC) compiles this into a signed HiringWorkflowIR from which a Hiring Decision Contract is projected. This replaces the hand-authored Role Compatibility Profile as the authoring surface.

requirements.description: What the role requires, declared plainly. The compiler derives dimensions, weights, gates, required evidence, and confidence thresholds from these.

mandatory.description: Non-negotiables that become non-compensatory Mandatory Gates.

operating_environment.description: Drives the Operating Environment Compatibility dimension (operating-model, not personal similarity).

emphasis.description: Optional relative emphasis hints per dimension the compiler normalizes into weights; NOT raw weights.

action_constraints.description: The approved bounds an offer/action must satisfy; compiled into the contract and enforced by the Hiring ActionGate.

approval_chain.description: Ordered HUMAN approver roles. The compiler rejects any non-human principal.
